termination_clauses: Either party may terminate with 45 days' prior written notice. NOTE: This is the correct notice period per the prevailing Arabic version; the English version incorrectly states 30 days (see data/ground_truth/discrepancies.json).
penalty_clauses: No additional penalties beyond those set out under Qatari labour law.
governing_law: Laws of the State of Qatar; jurisdiction of the Qatari courts.
language_precedence_clause: In case of conflict, the Arabic version shall prevail.
